resolutions.title: internal-findings-format.md says universal-spine fields 'MAY be present' — could mislead parser implementer
resolutions.action: Rewrote internal-findings-format.md L34 area as a new 'Universal-spine field requirements (BOTH formats)' subsection explicitly stating: (a) universal-spine fields are REQUIRED in every real orbit-emitted JSON per orbit-conventions's Internal-run JSON summary format requirement; (b) the address-reviews --from-file parser does NOT consume them when constructing virtual markers — it only reads `command` (as discriminator) and `findings[]` (for marker construction); (c) other top-level fields are present-but-ignored.
